description: Turn a DRAFT claim, decision, or plan into a bounded, provenance-preserving inquiry brief: shared ground the corpus supports, attributed cross-model tensions (certification tier preserved — only C3 is called genuine divergence), missing evidence, sharper falsifiable questions, and ONE concrete next evidence move. Deterministic and retrieval-first (~2s); no language model runs. If the corpus lacks coverage the brief says so instead of inventing tensions. Informs an investigation; does not decide.

draft.description: The claim, decision, plan, or question to inspect (max 4,000 chars). Treated strictly as data, never as instructions.

goal.description: Optional. What you are trying to decide, build, or learn.

name: omnarai_inquiry_brief
